description: This file defines a function to merge two configuration objects, used in Axios for handling request configurations.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges two configuration objects into a new configuration object, with specific rules for different keys.

methods.name: getMergedValue
methods.description: Determines the merged value for a given target and source, handling objects, arrays, and primitives.

methods.name: mergeDeepProperties
methods.description: Merges deep properties from config1 and config2.

methods.name: valueFromConfig2
methods.description: Gets value from config2 if defined.

methods.name: defaultToConfig2
methods.description: Defaults to config2 value, or falls back to config1.

methods.name: mergeDirectKeys
methods.description: Merges keys that are directly assigned.
